verdict.rationale:
TaxJar's API supports a `product_tax_code` parameter on each line_item so developers can classify products (e.g. digital goods code 20010) for jurisdiction-specific taxation, and GitHub docs confirm product-level tax rules exist. However, the evidence explicitly notes this covers only 'a subset of product categories,' with no full category taxonomy, per-jurisdiction coverage details, or guidance on mapping SaaS/services vs. physical goods comprehensively.

missing for 10: full category taxonomy/documentation, evidence of jurisdiction-specific taxability differences per category, coverage confirmation for SaaS/services categories specifically
